title: SAOS control
description: Schema for a single entry in a SAOS library/controls/*.yaml file. The YAML files contain a sequence of objects that each conform to this schema. Field semantics are documented in artefacts/02-methodology/CONTROL-SCHEMA.md.

id.description: Control identifier: DOMAIN-FAMILY-SEQUENCE, e.g. SRV-LOG-02. Must be unique across the whole library.

name.description: Control statement written as a positive assertion of the desired state.

plat.description: Platform the control applies to. 'All' means every platform in the domain scope.

obj.description: Objective: what the control achieves and why it is written this way.

biz.description: Business justification: the consequence if the control is absent, in business language.

q.description: Assessment question: the single question the assessor answers to test the control.

ev.description: Evidence required. Semicolon-separated list; each item becomes one row on the Evidence_Requests sheet and one ER-<control-id>-<n> request ID.

proc.description: Validation procedure: step-by-step test instructions. Use a YAML block scalar (|-) for multi-line text.

test.description: Permitted test methods, comma separated: INT, DOC, CFG, OBS, TECH, AUTO, PEN.

auto.description: Automation potential for evidence collection or testing.

autom.description: Automation method: the specific tool, API or query used to collect or test this control.

L.description: Default likelihood that the weakness is exploited within 12 months. Drives inherent risk before any client override.

I.description: Default impact if the weakness is exploited. Drives inherent risk before any client override.

w.description: Criticality weight used in domain and family weighted-average maturity: 1 low, 2 medium, 3 high.

m1.description: Maturity anchor for level 1 (Initial): what an organisation at level 1 looks like.

m3.description: Maturity anchor for level 3 (Defined): the minimum bar for a documented, operating control.

m5.description: Maturity anchor for level 5 (Optimized): what continuous improvement and automation look like.

rem.description: Remediation guidance: the concrete action that raises the control to the next level.

ref.description: Optional per-control reference override. When absent the family default from library/meta.yaml is used.

iso.description: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A controls. Comma separated, e.g. 'A.8.9, A.8.20'. Use 'N/A' if none.

csf.description: NIST CSF 2.0 subcategories. Must carry the function prefix, e.g. 'PR.PS-01, PR.IR-01'.

cis.description: CIS Controls v8.1 safeguards as major.minor, e.g. '4.6, 12.2'. Quote in YAML so it stays a string. Use 'N/A' if none.

soc.description: SOC 2 (2017 Trust Services Criteria) points, e.g. 'CC6.1, CC6.6'. Use 'N/A' if none.

att.description: MITRE ATT&CK mapping as TACTIC:technique[,technique] groups separated by '|', e.g. "'IA:T1190 | PS:T1542.001'". Use 'N/A' if none.

zt.description: NIST SP 800-207 Zero Trust pillars touched: ID, DV, NW, AP, DT, IN.

asvs.description: Optional OWASP ASVS chapter (V1-V14 for ASVS 4.0.3).

orig.description: Checklist origin: 'New' for SAOS-authored, or the source checklist reference (e.g. '1.1') when the control was ported from an existing checklist.
